definitions.explanation: The front surface or front part of something, such as a building or vehicle. Figuratively, the foreground: what is put forward or made the main point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前面|ぜんめん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧{張|ば}りだ。
examples.english: The front of the building is glass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前面|ぜんめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧へこんだ。
examples.english: The front of the car was badly dented.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{党|とう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{前面|ぜんめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{押|お}し{出|だ}した→押し出す：05765_oshidasu⟧。
examples.english: In this election, the party put childcare support front and center.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{前面|ぜんめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ / ⟦{押|お}し{出|だ}す→押し出す：05765_oshidasu⟧: to put X forward, to make X the main point
- {前面|ぜんめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand at the forefront

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{背面|はいめん}→背面：20610_haimen⟧: back, rear side
- ⟦{側面|そくめん}→側面：05779_sokumen⟧: side

WATCH OUT:
⟦{全面|ぜんめん}→全面：22735_zenmen⟧ (the whole surface; total, all-out) is read the same: ⟦{全面|ぜんめん}→全面：22735_zenmen⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (total ban), ⟦{全面的|ぜんめんてき}→全面的：05673_zenmenteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (fully). {前面|ぜんめん} is only the front.
